description: Calculates the child tax credit as Schedule 8812 does after the One Big Beautiful Bill Act: $2,200 per qualifying child under 17 for 2025 and 2026, $500 per other dependent, reduced by 5% of MAGI over $400,000 joint / $200,000 others (excess rounded up to the next $1,000), limited by tax liability, with the refundable additional child tax credit of up to $1,700 per child at 15% of earned income over $2,500. Amounts from the 2025 Schedule 8812 and Rev. Proc. 2025-32.

earned_income.description: Earned income for the refundable part. Defaults to MAGI.

magi.description: Modified adjusted gross income in USD (Form 1040 line 11b plus excluded foreign and Puerto Rico income).

other_dependents.description: Other dependents (credit for other dependents, $500 each).

qualifying_children.description: Children under 17 at year end with a valid SSN.

tax_liability_before_credits.description: Income tax before credits (Form 1040 line 18). Estimated from MAGI if left out.

name: calculate_child_tax_credit
title: Child tax credit (2025-2026)
